command:
set +e; echo '=== GO084 VOLATILE DB CONTRACTS READONLY ==='; date -Is; hostname; echo '--- ENTITYOS PATH CONFIG ---'; grep -E '^ENTITYOS_(ROOTFS_BASE|ROOTFS_RUN|DATA_DIR|VOICE_DIR|COGNITION_DIR|IDENTITY_BINDS)=' /etc/entityos/entityos.conf 2>/dev/null || true; paths='/var/lib/entityos/rootfs-run/root/.cache/Microsoft/DeveloperTools/.onnxruntime/onnxruntime.db /var/lib/entityos/rootfs-run/root/.local/share/frank/db/amygdala.db /var/lib/entityos/rootfs-run/root/.local/share/frank/db/world_experience.db /var/lib/entityos/rootfs-run/root/.local/share/agentzero/consciousness.db /var/lib/entityos/rootfs-run/root/.local/share/agentzero/unified.db'; for p in $paths; do echo; echo "### DB $p"; stat -c 'size=%s mtime=%y inode=%i owner=%U:%G' "$p" 2>&1; sha256sum "$p" 2>&1; echo '[tables]'; sqlite3 "file:$p?mode=ro" "SELECT type||'|'||name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type IN ('table','view') ORDER BY type,name;" 2>&1 | head -80; echo '[row counts]'; sqlite3 "file:$p?mode=ro" "SELECT 'schema_entries|'||count(*) FROM sqlite_master;" 2>&1; echo '[open pids]'; pids=$(lsof -t -- "$p" 2>/dev/null | sort -u | tr '
' ' '); echo "$pids"; for pid in $pids; do ps -p "$pid" -o pid=,ppid=,lstart=,args= 2>/dev/null; printf 'cwd='; readlink "/proc/$pid/cwd" 2>/dev/null; printf 'exe='; readlink "/proc/$pid/exe" 2>/dev/null; printf 'cgroup='; tr '
' ';' < "/proc/$pid/cgroup" 2>/dev/null; echo; done; done; echo; echo '--- SAME BASENAME OUTSIDE ROOTFS-RUN ---'; for b in onnxruntime.db amygdala.db world_experience.db consciousness.db unified.db; do echo "## $b"; find /var/lib/entityos/data /var/lib/entityos/voice /home/andreas/.local/share -xdev -type f -name "$b" -printf '%s %TY-%Tm-%TdT%TH:%TM:%TS %p
' 2>/dev/null | head -50; done; echo '--- TARGETED SOURCE REFERENCES ---'; for root in /var/lib/entityos/voice /home/andreas/frankenstein-repo /home/andreas/self-integration; do [ -d "$root" ] || continue; echo "## ROOT $root"; grep -RIn --exclude-dir=.git --include='*.py' --include='*.sh' --include='*.service' --include='*.toml' --include='*.json' -E 'world_experience\.db|amygdala\.db|consciousness\.db|agentzero/unified\.db|onnxruntime\.db' "$root" 2>/dev/null | head -120; done; echo '=== END ==='; exit 0
